what_it_actually_means: The buyer must place a successful order within 7 days of clicking that same creator's affiliate link. Not 7 days from the post going up - 7 days from the click, per click, which is why a post that keeps earning is a post that keeps getting clicked rather than one that ranked once.

Commission is computed at the Shopee and Xtra rates in force when the buyer placed the order, not when the creator posted. A campaign built on a rate screenshotted last week is a campaign built on a number that has no contractual life.

value: homepage and category and other non-product pages
what_it_actually_means: Xtra commission - the seller-funded half - is earned only on shop and product links. Link to the Shopee homepage or a category page and the Shopee half still pays while the seller half silently does not. The page states this as a best practice; it is a revenue rule.

value: Hoa hong Shopee plus Hoa hong Xtra
what_it_actually_means: Two payers behind one number. Shopee funds the base rate; the seller funds Xtra. A creator negotiating with a brand is negotiating only the second, and a creator quoting one blended percentage cannot tell which half moved when earnings drop.

value: direct and indirect and discovery and conversion
what_it_actually_means: Indirect orders count: a purchase from a completely different seller after the click is still commissionable. So affiliate earnings are not a read on the product you posted, and a creator attributing income to a specific video is usually wrong about which basket it came from.

The page says outright that both commission types are determined automatically by system algorithm and may change from time to time under the programme terms. There is no rate card to hold anyone to, which is the single most important thing to know before modelling affiliate income as revenue.

A service fee of 0.98 percent of everything the partner earns from the programme, VAT included, offset directly at reconciliation rather than invoiced. Small, and it comes off the top before anything else.

The 1 percent version, applied from the 16-31 May 2025 reconciliation period. Recorded because it is still live on its own URL with no superseded label, and because a two-month-old rate quoted as current is the ordinary failure mode here.

From 20 November 2025 personal income tax is withheld at 10 percent on any payment of 250000 VND or more to an individual partner. The threshold fell because payments went to twice a week, so the same monthly income now crosses it on nearly every instalment. In practice: assume 10 percent is withheld.

The 2000000 VND threshold from Thong tu 111/2013/TT-BTC Article 25.1(i), which Shopee's own tax explainer still states as current. Two pages on the same host disagree and the dated announcement is the one that governs. A model still carrying 2000000 understates withholding on almost every payment.

Ten percent withheld at source, and it is an advance rather than a final tax. Affiliate commission is remuneration under Thong tu 111/2013/TT-BTC Article 2.2(c), so the individual files an annual return on the progressive scale and overpayment is refundable. A creator who never files is donating the difference.
Stated inside the tax announcement rather than on the payment page: the current frequency for individual partners is twice a week. The payment-process article was never updated to match.

The two-cycle description still published as the payment process: orders from the 16th to month end reconciled from the 11th of the next month, orders from the 1st to the 15th reconciled from the 24th, each paid within about 30 working days of complete documents. Superseded by the twice-weekly cadence and still the first page a partner finds.

Business partners are paid once a month, with 8 or 9 daily payment statements generated per period depending on month length, and the reconciliation email within 10 working days after the last statement is issued. Cadence now differs by partner type, so a company and an individual promoting the same product are on different receivable clocks.

MCN partners reconcile the whole previous month from the 11th, then payment within about 30 working days of Shopee holding complete valid documents. The longest clock of the three, and the one an agency signs its own creators onto.

unit: orders per day over 3 consecutive months
what_it_actually_means: To move an existing individual account to a company or household-business account you need a daily average above 500 orders over the last 3 consecutive months, an assigned Shopee contact, and the ability to issue invoices. Shopee supports the switch exactly once, ever. This is the real line between affiliate as side income and affiliate as a business.

New MCN registration is an email with a business licence, official channels, a proposal covering services, capabilities, roadmap, live or campaign case studies, and the KOL network. Reply within 7 working days of a complete file.
Definition 1.2 of the seller programme terms: visit information is retained for 7 days on both the app and the website.

Definition 1.4 counts a Successful Order when the visitor completes a purchase within 30 days of being brought to the marketplace. That is four times the creator-side window and it sits in the same document as a 7-day cookie, which the terms never reconcile. Model both and confirm the operative one with your Shopee contact before it goes in a forecast.

value: cancelled and returned and refused and bot and prefilled and policy-violating
what_it_actually_means: Definition 1.4 excludes cancelled orders, refused deliveries and returns under the refund policy, orders from bots spiders and scripts, and orders using pre-filled data fields - and states that Shopee is not obliged to explain or prove any individual decision. Returns therefore remove commission after it was reported, which is why a return rate is an input to any affiliate model and not a footnote.

Business individuals, household businesses and domestic companies joining the seller programme need a daily average above 50 orders over 3 months and then sign a service contract. Non-business individuals have no such threshold. Note the gap against the 500-per-day figure for converting a creator account - two programmes, two thresholds, an order of magnitude apart.

Below a 10000 VND minimum, Shopee reserves the right to hold the payment - including when the account has been locked. Trivial for a working programme and the reason a dormant one never pays out at all.

Payment documents are due within 6 months of the commission arising for a non-business individual and within 30 days for a business individual, household business or company. Miss it and Shopee reserves the right not to pay. The stricter deadline lands on the partner who has accountants.

Under 20 percent violating orders in a reconciliation window and Shopee pays on the clean remainder. At 20 percent or above in one month, or across 3 months consecutive or not since approval, Shopee may lock the affiliate account and the Shopee account with it. One number separates a deduction from the end of the channel.
Delete your own Shopee account and Shopee reserves the right to refuse payment of commission already earned. Worth knowing before consolidating accounts.

Up to 10000000 VND per instance of prohibited conduct, VAT included, cumulative across instances, and Shopee decides unilaterally whether to offset it against what it owes you or invoice you for it. Posted 5 September 2024 and effective 7 days later. This is the number that makes the prohibited list worth reading properly.

Bidding on the Shopee brand or its private labels in search advertising is prohibited without prior written consent, and the policy says the term must be treated as a negative keyword. Any Vietnamese performance marketer running search to a Shopee listing is one broad-match campaign away from this clause.

Item (a) of the prohibited list: advertising email promoting Shopee requires Shopee's prior written approval. A newsletter with affiliate links in it is inside this clause, which is not how anyone treats their own mailing list.

value: using another person's content without permission
what_it_actually_means: Item (n) makes taking someone else's content and posting it publicly a fraud violation carrying the same charge as fake orders. The platform's own affiliate policy is stricter on image rights than most agency practice, and it is enforced by withholding money.

value: bots and emulators and inflated engagement
what_it_actually_means: Items (b) (t) and (w) cover robots and automated tools, emulators and device spoofing, and interference with views interactions follows purchases clicks bulk video creation and livestream replays. Buying engagement to qualify for a programme tier is inside the same clause as order fraud.

value: fake and proxy and resale-intent orders
what_it_actually_means: Item (o) prohibits soliciting or placing fake orders, ordering on someone's behalf, and ordering to resell on or off Shopee. Item (k) separately prohibits posting a bare link with no content or sending the same link to the same audience - the two habits a struggling affiliate reaches for first.

The documented form is s.shopee.vn/an_redir?origin_link={urlencoded landing page}&affiliate_id={id}&sub_id={v1}-{v2}-{v3}-{v4}-{v5}, and the resolved link carries utm_medium=affiliates, utm_source=an_{affiliate_id} and the sub_id in utm_content. Five dash-separated slots is the only campaign taxonomy a creator controls, and since the delimiter is a dash, a value containing one splits the field.

Where a platform blocks affiliate links, Shopee issues a product code in the form BFD-ZBE-BDY - dash required, case-insensitive - which a follower pastes into Shopee search, and the page states this is recorded the same as a click from a social affiliate link. That makes attributed affiliate revenue possible on surfaces that strip links, which is most of them.

Shopee states 9:16 at a minimum resolution of 540x960, audio and on-screen language in Vietnamese or English, and no screen recordings, GIFs or static images. The resolution floor is low enough that phone footage passes and the content rules are what actually gate distribution.

value: 18 plus with Page or professional profile
what_it_actually_means: Open to creators aged 18 or over holding a Facebook Page or a professional profile. A shared Shopee affiliate link renders a product banner automatically in two positions, currently showing only the first product in the link.

value: fixed fee paid by the seller
what_it_actually_means: Pay per Post is the seller-pays half of the same system: the seller funds a fixed fee to co-create content rather than a commission on orders. Invitation-based, and the creator sets their own price per channel and format inside the affiliate console - but only on social channels they have verified. This is the platform-native rate card, and it is the answer to what should I charge.

value: company and household business and individual
what_it_actually_means: Three regimes. Companies and household businesses sign a service contract, need a tax code and a registered line of business such as marketing brokerage, advertising or digital content services, and must issue valid invoices. Individuals accept online terms and have tax withheld. Registering as an individual while operating as a business means you are treated as an individual, with an individual's obligations - Thong tu 105/2020/TT-BTC for tax codes, Thong tu 103/2014/TT-BTC for foreign partners.

Measured on 31 July 2026 rather than assumed: affiliate.tiktok.com answers 200 with 37 characters of visible text, seller-vn.tiktok.com serves no robots.txt at all, and affiliate-vn.tiktok.com does not resolve. TikTok Shop's affiliate commission and payout terms are therefore not citable without a seller or creator login, while Shopee's are fully published. Plan for one channel whose rules you can quote and one whose rules you must screenshot from inside the account.
